events.text: {npc} spots you at the noodle stall and sits down uninvited. 'The broth is better with company,' {he} says.

choices.text: Talk until the bowls are cold

effects.log: By the end you know {his} whole family history.
Sometimes silence is the best conversation.

events.text: {npc} is trying to fix a torn fishing net before a storm. {He} is losing.

effects.log: Your fingers ache. The net holds. So does a friendship.
Light makes everything easier. {He} thanks you all night.

events.text: {npc} plays a bamboo flute on the riverbank every evening. Tonight {he} waves you over.

effects.log: The tune is sad and beautiful. {He} plays it for you every evening after.
You sound like a goose. {He} laughs and teaches you anyway.

events.text: You and {npc} are walking the same road for a week. You keep ending up at the same inns.

effects.log: A week of shared fires and stories. {He} feels like an old friend by the end.

mem.note: shared a dinner on the road

effects.log: One good dinner, and a promise to meet again.

events.text: {npc} trains at the same waterfall every morning. {He} nods to you. You nod back. Today {he} says something.

effects.log: You correct each other's stances. Both of you get better.
Still nodding every morning. It is a quiet kind of friendship.

events.text: {npc} is ill and alone in a rented room. Nobody has visited in a week.

choices.text: Bring food and stay a while

mem.note: nursed me when I was alone

effects.log: {He} recovers, and tells everyone who stayed.
The physician is good. {npc} wishes it had been you, but is grateful.

events.text: {npc} tells you the worst joke you have ever heard. You laugh anyway, then cannot stop.

effects.log: A war of bad jokes begins. It lasts for years.
{He} is delighted. Friendship sealed.

events.text: {npc} is moving house and has only a handcart and too much furniture.

effects.log: A long day. {He} cooks you dinner in the new house.
Faster, easier. {He} is amazed you knew someone with an ox.

events.text: {npc} knows the name of every star and wants to teach someone before {he} forgets.

effects.log: A summer of night lessons. You never look at the sky the same way.
{He} laughs and uses your names from then on.

events.text: {npc} tells you a story about the war {he} fought in when {he} was young. {He} has never told anyone.

effects.log: When {he} finishes, {he} looks lighter.

choices.text: Share a hard story of your own

effects.log: Two hard stories, one long night, one real friendship.

events.text: {npc} has cooked far too much festival food and insists you take half.

effects.log: A feast for two. The best kind.

choices.text: Take it to share with the poor

mem.note: shared my food with the poor

effects.log: {npc} is surprised, then proud of you.

events.text: {npc} carves little wooden animals. {He} has carved one that looks exactly like you.

effects.log: {He} is delighted. You keep it on your shelf all your life.
Your first animal looks like a potato. {He} keeps it anyway.

events.text: {npc} is sorting old things and finds a toy you made as a child.

effects.log: An afternoon of old memories.
It works again. {He} puts it on the shrine.

variants: Clearing out an old chest, {npc} holds up a toy you made as a child, lopsided and unmistakable.

events.text: {npc} wants help making dumplings for the whole family.

effects.log: Your dumplings fall apart. Everyone eats them anyway.
{He} is astonished. Where did you learn?

variants: {npc} has a mountain of dough and a feast to make, and wants another pair of hands for the dumplings.

events.text: {npc} is weeding the vegetable patch alone in the heat.

effects.log: A long, quiet morning. Good soil, good company.

choices.text: Bring water and sit in the shade with {him}

effects.log: The weeds can wait an hour.

variants: {npc} is out in the vegetable patch at midday, pulling weeds alone in the heat.
The sun is high and {npc} is still bent over the vegetable rows, weeding by {him}self.

events.text: {npc} has to give a speech at a wedding and is terrified. {He} begs you to help write it.

ok.log: The whole wedding weeps. {npc} is a hero.

fail.log: The speech is fine. {npc} is grateful.

choices.text: Tell {him} to speak from the heart

effects.log: {He} does. It is short and perfect.

events.text: {npc} has lost {his} grandmother's jade pendant somewhere in the market.

ok.log: You find it in a gutter. {npc} weeps.

fail.log: You search all day. It is gone.

effects.log: It was sold to a pawnshop that morning. You buy it back.

events.text: {npc} is being bullied by {his} boss at work, who takes half {his} wages.

choices.text: Have a word with the boss

ok.log: The boss suddenly remembers how to be fair.

mem.note: tried to help with my boss

fail.log: The boss fires {npc}. You help {him} find better work.

effects.log: A better job, a fairer boss.

events.text: {npc} needs to cross the bandit-infested pass to reach a dying relative, and asks you to come.

ok.log: No bandits dare. {npc} arrives in time.

mem.note: bled for me in the pass

fail.log: Bandits attack. You get {him} through, bleeding.

effects.log: Hired guards take {him} safely.

events.text: {npc} is taking the civil exam and begs you to quiz {him} every night for a month.

effects.log: A month of flashcards. {He} passes. You learned half the classics by accident.
{He} passes anyway, barely.

events.text: {npc}'s shop burned down in the night. {He} is sitting in the ashes.

effects.log: A month of carpentry. The new shop is better than the old one.

mem.note: gave me silver after the fire

effects.log: {He} cries, and promises to repay you.

events.text: {npc}'s family wants to marry {him} to someone {he} has never met. {He} asks you to speak to them.

mem.note: spoke to my family for me

ok.log: The family agrees to let {him} choose.

mem.note: tried to help with my marriage

fail.log: The family is offended. The marriage goes ahead.

effects.log: A night escape. {He} writes to you from a far city, happy.

events.text: {npc} whispers to you in the market: 'Do not buy salt this week. The price will crash. You {debt}; now we are even.'

effects.log: The price crashes. You buy cheap next week. (+10 taels)
{He} just smiles. 'I owed you, not an explanation.'

events.text: You fall sick, and {npc} arrives with a physician and pays for everything. 'You {debt}.'

effects.log: You recover quickly. The debt is closed.
{He} refuses to hear it. You recover anyway.

events.text: {npc} introduces you to an old master who agrees to give you one lesson. 'You {debt}. This is my thanks.'

effects.log: One lesson, worth a year of training.

choices.text: Give the lesson to a younger student

effects.log: {npc} is surprised, and even more grateful.

events.text: Someone slanders you in a teahouse. {npc} stands up and defends you before you even hear about it. 'You {debt}.'

effects.log: Your name is clear. {npc} feels the debt is paid.
You drink to old debts.

events.text: {npc} runs up out of breath. 'Men are waiting for you at the ford. You {debt}; take the bridge.'

effects.log: You avoid the ambush. The debt is settled.

choices.text: Go to the ford and surprise them

ok.log: You catch them napping. They run.

fail.log: They were ready. You get away.

events.text: {npc} leaves wildflowers on your doorstep every morning for a week. On the seventh day, {he} is there when you open the door.

effects.log: Tea, then dinner, then many more dinners.

choices.text: Thank {him} and say you need time

effects.log: {He} understands. The flowers keep coming, but fewer.

events.text: {npc} pulls you out of a river after you slip on the bank, and does not let go of your hand for a long moment.

mem.note: held my hand by the river

effects.log: Neither of you speaks. Neither needs to.

mem.note: laughed with me by the river

effects.log: You laugh together, soaked. Something has changed.

events.text: At a poetry gathering, {npc}'s poem is clearly about you. Everyone knows it.

choices.text: Answer with a poem of your own

effects.log: The whole gathering holds its breath. {npc} blushes to the ears.
{npc} looks disappointed. Then hopeful. Then disappointed.

events.text: {npc} has mended the tear in your robe without asking, with stitches finer than any tailor's.

effects.log: {He} notices every time. You notice {him} noticing.
Hours side by side, needles and laughter.

events.text: {npc} blocks your way in the crowded market. 'You {grudge}. I have not forgotten. Draw, here, now.'

ok.log: You win in front of the whole market. {npc} is humiliated.

effects.log: The market jeers. {npc} is not satisfied.

events.text: A letter from {npc}, written in blood: 'The old mill, at dusk. You {grudge}.'

ok.log: At dusk you leave the mill alone. {npc} leaves it limping.

fail.log: {npc} has brought friends. You get away.

effects.log: You do not go. {npc} tells everyone you are a coward.

events.text: Rumour says you poisoned a rival's horse. {npc} started it, and everyone believes {him}.

ok.log: It was a jealous stablehand. The rumour dies. {npc} looks foolish.

fail.log: You cannot prove it. The rumour sticks for a year.

effects.log: People forget, eventually.

events.text: {npc} is telling people you owe money to every gambling den in town.

choices.text: Pay a visit to every gambling den, publicly, to not gamble

effects.log: The joke spreads faster than the rumour.

events.text: A guard confesses that someone paid the gatehouse to leave the gate unlocked tonight. The someone sounds like {npc}.

effects.log: A figure tries the gate at midnight, then runs.
The constable waits by the gate. The plotter never comes.

events.text: In a quiet teahouse, the other customers stand up at once. {npc} is at the door.

ok.log: Tables fly. You leave. {npc} does not follow.

fail.log: You escape through the kitchen, bleeding.

ok.log: Out the window, over the roofs, gone.

fail.log: They catch you in the alley.

effects.log: You pour yourself more tea and wait. {npc} talks for a long time about what you owe. In the end the false customers beat you once, for form's sake, and leave. It is a humiliation, not a grave.

events.text: {npc}, your partner in a venture, has run off with all the silver.

ok.log: You find {him} in the next town and get most of it back.

fail.log: {He} is gone. The silver is gone.

effects.log: An expensive lesson in trust.
